ValidationRule.description: The step itself proves the user confirmed before a write action ran.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISNEW(), ISPICKVAL(StepType__c, "Workflow Action"), RequiredConfirmation__c, ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Success"), OR(ISBLANK(ConfirmedBy__c), ISBLANK(ConfirmedDate__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: An action that required confirmation cannot be recorded as successful without who confirmed it and when.
